purpose: Teach: 突撃/下半身/名言/セレブ/鍼/歌舞伎町/ベッカム/旅人

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが歴史番組の突撃のシーンを観てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was watching this history program with a really dramatic scene.
lines.style: Light, conversational tone. Sharing something she noticed. Warm acknowledgment of what dad was doing. Natural pacing, like mentioning a small moment from the day.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、下半身を鍛えたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to get stronger — like, build up my legs.
lines.style: Earnest, genuine interest. Not performing excitement but genuine curiosity about his own body. Clear request, no trailing hesitation. The directness of a 6-year-old asking what he actually wants.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「失敗は成功のもと」って名言を仰ったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said something really wise — 'failure is the mother of success.'
lines.style: Gentle delivery of something meaningful. Not lecturing but sharing what she heard. Slight pride in what dad said. Measured pace, letting the words land without rushing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんがセレブの伝記を読んで下さったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad read me a celebrity biography — he sat with me the whole time.
lines.style: Soft wonder in his voice. Noticing that dad gave him time. Not bragging but reporting something that mattered. Small genuine laugh underneath the words.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが鍼治療に通われてるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been going to acupuncture appointments regularly.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but gentle. Sharing information without making a big deal of it. Like she's letting Sho in on something she noticed about dad. Steady, unremarkable tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと歌舞伎町は危ないって学んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me that Kabukicho is dangerous — we talked about why.
lines.style: Quiet seriousness. He learned something from an actual conversation with dad. Not scared, but sobered. Small-voiced and observant, the way he holds onto what matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがベッカム選手の本を貸して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's lending you a book about Beckham — he said you could borrow it.
lines.style: Warm news delivered plainly. She's relaying something kind that dad is doing. Small smile underneath. Natural rhythm, like sharing good news about what someone did.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと旅人ごっこしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I pretended to be travelers — we had this whole adventure together.
lines.style: Bright recollection of something fun. Not loud but alive with the memory. Quick, light pacing on the good part. Trailing warmth at the end — he's still holding onto how that felt.
